title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: what amount a demurrage rate or free-time dispute is lodged for
content:
## Scope

This rule of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category fixes the starting figure for the amount a billed party disputes on a demurrage invoice line of a per-container record, and when the stated amount is used instead.

## Rule

1. A billed party disputing a demurrage invoice line on the rate-misapplied or free-time-misapplied ground disputes the amount still open on that line.
2. The amount still open is the line's amount less every waiver and dispute credit already booked with the line as the invoice line they refer to, including waivers granted by the operations department. It is never taken below nothing.
3. A dispute on any other ground, or on a detention line, is lodged for the amount the billed party states.

## Decision table

| Line | Ground | Starting figure of the dispute |
|---|---|---|
| demurrage | rate misapplied or free time misapplied | the amount still open on the line |
| demurrage | invoice issued late, incorrect event dates, carrier-caused delay or terminal closure | the amount the billed party states |
| detention | any ground | the amount the billed party states |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A demurrage line of USD 900.00 has had an operations department waiver of USD 120.00 booked against it and nothing else. The amount still open is USD 780.00, and the operations waiver is taken off even though the desk did not grant it.

## Points of judgement

**Q: The customer wants to dispute the full invoiced USD 900.00 on a rate ground. Is that the figure?**
A: No. A rate or free-time dispute on a demurrage line starts from the amount still open, after every waiver and dispute credit already booked against the line.
